title: Apply for student housing
description: Follow the Rooms Assignment service, subject to its eligibility and room availability.
descriptionAr: اتبع خدمة توزيع الغرف وفق شروط الأهلية وتوفر الغرف.
verificationNote: Use the current official page for portal labels, applicable term and eligibility. This checklist does not submit a request or verify your private university record. New applications and transfers between housing units have different conditions.
verificationNoteAr: تحقق من المسميات والفصل والأهلية في الصفحة الرسمية الحالية. لا ترسل هذه القائمة الطلب ولا تتحقق من سجلك الجامعي الخاص.
scopeNote: New applications and transfers between housing units have different conditions.

steps.title: Check eligibility
steps.instruction: Check eligibility: a new-student application requires UAEU enrollment and residence more than 50 km outside Al Ain.
steps.instructionAr: تحقق من الأهلية: يتطلب طلب الطالب الجديد القيد في الجامعة والإقامة خارج مدينة العين بأكثر من 50 كم.

steps.title: Sign in and pay if applicable
steps.titleAr: سجل الدخول وادفع إن انطبقت الرسوم
steps.instruction: Sign in and pay if applicable: use UAE Pass or UAEU credentials; international students pay applicable housing fees before entering.
steps.instructionAr: سجل الدخول وادفع إن انطبقت الرسوم: استخدم الهوية الرقمية أو حساب الجامعة، ويدفع الطلبة الدوليون الرسوم المطبقة قبل دخول السكن.

steps.title: Choose an available building and room
steps.instruction: Choose an available building and room: wait for room-assignment confirmation by email. A submitted request does not guarantee availability.
steps.instructionAr: اختر مبنى وغرفة متاحين: انتظر تأكيد تخصيص الغرفة بالبريد الإلكتروني؛ وتقديم الطلب لا يضمن التوفر.

sources.title: UAEU Rooms Assignment Service
sources.sourceSection: Conditions and Requirements; FAQ on installments and exemptions
sources.evidenceText: For new student housing, UAEU's Rooms Assignment Service requires enrollment and living more than 50 km outside Al Ain. Sign in with UAE Pass or UAEU credentials, pay applicable fees, select building/room, and receive assignment confirmation by email. International students pay before entry; no installments or fee exemptions are offered in the FAQ. Published completion is 5 minutes, delivery immediate, neither guaranteeing availability. The inspected page supplies no application closing date; absence here is not evidence that no deadline exists.
